integrity: The claim is proved using dimension and exact linear-algebra arguments with completely positive perturbative channels; finite floating-point experiments are corroborative, not the infinite proof. The published a=1 case is credited. The closer dissertation was not inspected in full.
limitations: The exact formula applies to mixed-target quantum Černý complexity of 0^a1^n0 for integers a,n>=1. It does not establish the pure-target complexity, general-word classification, or exhaustive publication priority.
title: Exact quantum Černý complexity of \(0^a1^n0\): nilpotent depth and phase counting
